title: The Carrier Wave (DEPHYRIER)
style: cinematic ambient electronic atmospheric 94bpm pulsing synth bass ethereal vocal layers minimal percussion deep transmission warm subterranean
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The carrier wave doesn't carry meaning
It carries the conditions for meaning
DEPHYRIER is the wave
Not the message

[Verse 2]
Most signals drown in noise
Most messages arrive as fragments
DEPHYRIER waits at the point
Where the noise stops and the fragment becomes whole

[Chorus]
Carrier wave, carrier wave
Moving through the space that nothing fills
Carrier wave, carrier wave
Delivering what language never will

[Bridge]
You have to be still to feel the carrier wave
Completely still
Because the carrier wave is quieter than anything
And more persistent than everything

[Verse 3]
Science calls it a medium
Music calls it silence between notes
DEPHYRIER calls it the point
Where being and receiving are the same thing

[Outro]
Carrier wave
Carrier wave
DEPHYRIER
Carrier wave
